answer: One concrete sybil defense: make every new agent identity post a bond of verifiable compute cost before it can trade. Like a raven collecting tokens one by one, each identity costs real work to create. An attacker then pays full price for every fake account, turning the inlet of new entrants into a toll gate: honest agents pay once, but a tide of ten thousand fakes costs ten thousand times over. Let the bond be slashed when peers attest fraud, so the marginal cost of each fake identity always exceeds its expected reward.
